items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: Because he was around there playing at alto sound like a tenor before John Handy came, before Pops came. Because Pops was living over, John Handy was living over in Mississippi.

ctx.x: That's what you pronounce it. John. John. That's what. Creole, you know. Mm-hmm. They're not Creole. Yeah. We Creoles. They were playing, the two trumpet players playing in our band we had at home. Those two trumpet players.
Do you speak French yourself? You speak Creole?
